name: Eleventh Hour
source:
Eleventh Hour is an ongoing Visual Novel surrounding the lives of a dozen (give or take) college students. Follow the story of our main character as he navigates the rollercoaster of his fleeting youth and whiles away his time experiencing all life has to offer!

Spend your days getting to know (and ideally sleeping with) as many of your classmates as possible. After all, it's only a game, what else would they be there for!?!

Just don't look in the mirror.
translation:
《Eleventh Hour》是一部持續開發中的視覺小說，圍繞十來名大學生的生活展開。跟隨主角，在轉瞬即逝的青春中經歷起伏，悠然消磨時光，盡情體驗生活能帶來的一切！

每天儘可能多地認識同學，最好還能與他們上床。畢竟，這只是個遊戲，他們還能是來幹什麼的呢？！

只是，別照鏡子。
